summary: Mobile signup screen parity with web verified. All UI blocks (role selector, caregiver care-recipient block + relationship chips, plan picker, second-participant toggle) render and behave correctly. Full signup for BOTH (caregiver+Family+2nd participant) and (participant+Solo) succeeds with correct role/plan on POST /api/auth/signup and transitions to signup-payment-gate. Persona PUT and v2/participants POST are best-effort and both returned 200 in the Family run.
critical_code_review_comments: signup.tsx onSignup uses evaluatePassword which flags any password containing user's first-name substring (>2 chars). This matches web behaviour, but the error copy 'Password should not include your name or email.' surprised the tester when using 'MobTest1!' with first_name 'Mob'. Consider showing the containsIdentity rule inline in the live checklist so users don't have to submit to discover it.

signup.tsx line 197 uses testID 'signup-payment-gate' — good. However the payment gate 'Add card & start free trial' Button is rendered inside a loading state (spinner) because completePayment() is invoked automatically on submit success; the Button element is present but visually a spinner. Consider disabling with a clearer label instead of just spinner.

The mobile signup screen file is 512 lines and mixes payment-gate view + signup form. Consider splitting the payment-gate view into a small subcomponent for readability (parity file split with web is optional but nice).
